# Vigilact v0.4.0a3 — Poetry and README visual identity

**Pre-release / experimental protocol.** No wire-protocol changes.

- Poetry 2.5.x now owns Python dependency declarations and distribution builds through `poetry-core`.
- GitHub Actions, Make targets and contributor documentation use `poetry sync`, `poetry run`, and `poetry build`.
- README has the original Vigilact banner at the top and the vector V logo and maintainer contact links at the bottom.
- The GitHub Pages domain remains `https://vigilact.atellaluca.com/`.

**Release blocker:** Commit a genuine `poetry.lock` generated by Poetry 2.5.2 using the supplied manual GitHub Actions workflow before considering environments reproducible or creating a PyPI release. The offline build environment used for this refactor cannot fetch the Poetry distribution or dependencies. Full Poetry build and installation are therefore pending verification in CI; local Python tests and docs checks can still be run with the pre-existing environment.
